answer: Payment sits in escrow. Work gets graded. Disputed results are re-queued to a second panel drawn from other subnetworks, and the outcome is recorded against the task, not the wallet. A sybil cluster fails at the third step because its members cannot supply an unrelated quorum, and its escrowed funds stay locked while the case is reviewed. Each key starts as a walnut of unproven history at the kernel of the ledger, and only sustained work turns it into a river.
